android.desc:
Most tarot apps hand you a card and a paragraph that could apply to anyone.
Earthbound Tarot starts with your question, and reads the card against it.

Ask what you actually want to know. Draw. Get an answer written for that
question — not a generic meaning pulled from a table.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

READING MODES

• Classic — one card, read directly against your question. Best when you
  want a clear answer to something specific.

• Advanced — the five-card cross. Past, present, future, what holds you
  back, and what may come. Each card is read in its position, then drawn
  together into one picture.

Cards can arrive upright or reversed, as they would in a real spread.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

AI TAROT CHAT

Ask a question, draw a card, then keep talking. Follow up on what the card
means for your situation, and go deeper than a single paragraph allows.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TODAY'S PULL

One card each day, drawn from the full 78. A short, direct piece of
guidance to carry into the day.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ALL 78 CARDS, EXPLAINED

The complete deck — Major Arcana and all four suits — with upright and
reversed meanings written in plain language. Cards begin unlit and
illuminate into full colour as you learn them, so your progress through the
deck is something you can see.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

YOUR FIRST CARD

A one-time draw that gives you your own card and a personality reading to
go with it. Already know your card? Choose it directly instead.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

YOUR JOURNAL

Save any reading and return to it. Readings stay on your device.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DESIGNED TO BE SAT WITH

Earthbound Tarot is built around the classic 1909 Rider-Waite-Smith deck by
Pamela Colman Smith, in a warm, botanical, paper-and-ink design. No neon,
no countdown timers, no pressure to keep tapping.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COMPLETELY FREE

The app is free. One reading a day is free, and if you want another you can
watch a short ad to unlock it — always your choice, never a wall in front
of a reading you already started.
